# KaTeX 0.18.7

Vendored from https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.18.7.tgz.
Upstream: https://katex.org/ · MIT license in LICENSE.

The minified script, stylesheet and original fonts are bundled so extension pages
can render math without remote scripts or network requests. Update these files
together, then synchronize Edge and run the resource and math rendering tests.
